method: Outcomes collapsed to burn (burned, flame_spread, completed, disruption) vs no-burn (extinguished, self_extinguished, no_ignition); rows with other outcomes are skipped. Prediction = inverse-distance-weighted kNN (k=5, power 2) in normalized O2/pressure/flow space with fuel-phase, material and gravity penalties (src/lib/evidence.ts).

backtests.name: leave-one-test-out
backtests.description: Each test is hidden in turn and its burn / no-burn outcome is predicted from all other tests (other tests of the same investigation included).

backtests.name: leave-one-investigation-out
backtests.description: Hide an experiment: all tests of one investigation are removed and each is estimated from the other investigations only. An investigation passes when at least 75% of its tests are handled honestly: the outcome is predicted correctly, or the system flagged the point as Extrapolated instead of claiming knowledge.
